verses.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. O LORD, You have searched me and known me.

xrefs.text: Nothing in all creation is hidden from God’s sight; everything is uncovered and exposed before the eyes of Him to whom we must give account.
But You know me, O LORD; You see me and test my heart toward You. Drag away the wicked like sheep to the slaughter and set them apart for the day of carnage.
The heart is deceitful above all things and beyond cure. Who can understand it?
would not God have discovered, since He knows the secrets of the heart?
You have tried my heart; You have visited me in the night. You have tested me and found no evil; I have resolved not to sin with my mouth.

verses.text: You know when I sit and when I rise; You understand my thoughts from afar.

xrefs.text: But Jesus knew what they were thinking and said, “Why do you harbor evil in your hearts?
But I know your sitting down, your going out and coming in, and your raging against Me.
But I know your sitting down, your going out and coming in, and your raging against Me.
But Jesus, knowing the thoughts of their hearts, had a little child stand beside Him.
The eyes of the LORD are in every place, observing the evil and the good.

verses.text: You search out my path and my lying down; You are aware of all my ways.

xrefs.text: “Can a man hide in secret places where I cannot see him?” declares the LORD. “Do I not fill the heavens and the earth?” declares the LORD.
Does He not see my ways and count my every step?
Meanwhile Jacob left Beersheba and set out for Haran.
Why be captivated, my son, by an adulteress, or embrace the bosom of a stranger?
If I were to count them, they would outnumber the grains of sand; and when I awake, I am still with You.

verses.text: Even before a word is on my tongue, You know all about it, O LORD.

xrefs.text: For the word of God is living and active. Sharper than any double-edged sword, it pierces even to dividing soul and spirit, joints and marrow. It judges the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be pleasing in Your sight, O LORD, my Rock and my Redeemer.
You unleash your mouth for evil and harness your tongue to deceit.
You asked, ‘Who is this who conceals My counsel without knowledge?’ Surely I spoke of things I did not understand, things too wonderful for me to know.
The good man brings good things out of his good store of treasure, and the evil man brings evil things out of his evil store of treasure.

verses.text: You hem me in behind and before; You have laid Your hand upon me.

xrefs.text: The angel of the LORD encamps around those who fear Him, and he delivers them.
The eternal God is your dwelling place, and underneath are the everlasting arms. He drives out the enemy before you, giving the command, ‘Destroy him!’
When I saw Him, I fell at His feet like a dead man. But He placed His right hand on me and said, “Do not be afraid. I am the First and the Last,
If I go east, He is not there, and if I go west, I cannot find Him.
But God did not lay His hand on the nobles of Israel; they saw Him, and they ate and drank.

verses.text: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me, too lofty for me to attain.

xrefs.text: O, the depth of the riches of the wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable are His judgments, and untraceable His ways!
You asked, ‘Who is this who conceals My counsel without knowledge?’ Surely I spoke of things I did not understand, things too wonderful for me to know.
Can you fathom the deep things of God or discover the limits of the Almighty?
Many, O LORD my God, are the wonders You have done, and the plans You have for us— none can compare to You— if I proclaim and declare them, they are more than I can count.
Indeed, these are but the fringes of His ways; how faint is the whisper we hear of Him! Who then can understand the thunder of His power?”

verses.text: Where can I go to escape Your Spirit? Where can I flee from Your presence?

xrefs.text: “Am I only a God nearby,” declares the LORD, “and not a God far away?”

Jonah, however, got up to flee to Tarshish, away from the presence of the LORD. He went down to Joppa and found a ship bound for Tarshish. So he paid the fare and went aboard to sail for Tarshish, away from the presence of the LORD.
Then the men were even more afraid and said to him, “What have you done?” The men knew that he was fleeing from the presence of the LORD, because he had told them.

verses.text: If I ascend to the heavens, You are there; if I make my bed in Sheol, You are there.

xrefs.text: Though they dig down to Sheol, from there My hand will take them; and though they climb up to heaven, from there I will pull them down.
saying: “In my distress I called to the LORD, and He answered me. From the belly of Sheol I called for help, and You heard my voice.
For His eyes are on the ways of a man, and He sees his every step.
Though you soar like the eagle and make your nest among the stars, even from there I will bring you down,” declares the LORD.
Sheol and Abaddon lie open before the LORD— how much more the hearts of men!

verses.text: If I rise on the wings of the dawn, if I settle by the farthest sea,

xrefs.text: it rises at one end of the heavens and runs its circuit to the other; nothing is deprived of its warmth.
The day is Yours, and also the night; You established the moon and the sun.
“But for you who fear My name, the sun of righteousness will rise with healing in its wings, and you will go out and leap like calves from the stall.

verses.text: even there Your hand will guide me; Your right hand will hold me fast.

xrefs.text: He restores my soul; He guides me in the paths of righteousness for the sake of His name.
For I am the LORD your God, who takes hold of your right hand and tells you: Do not fear, I will help you.
Yet I am always with You; You hold my right hand.
My soul clings to You; Your right hand upholds me.
Deliver me from my enemies, O LORD; I flee to You for refuge.

verses.text: If I say, “Surely the darkness will hide me, and the light become night around me”—

xrefs.text: He reveals the deep things of darkness and brings deep shadows into light.
“Can a man hide in secret places where I cannot see him?” declares the LORD. “Do I not fill the heavens and the earth?” declares the LORD.
They say, “The LORD does not see; the God of Jacob pays no heed.”
He says to himself, “God has forgotten; He hides His face and never sees.”
Is not God as high as the heavens? Look at the highest stars, how lofty they are!

verses.text: even the darkness is not dark to You, but the night shines like the day, for darkness is as light to You.

xrefs.text: He reveals the deep and hidden things; He knows what lies in darkness, and light dwells with Him.
There is no darkness or deep shadow where the workers of iniquity can hide.
And the people stood at a distance as Moses approached the thick darkness where God was.
Nothing in all creation is hidden from God’s sight; everything is uncovered and exposed before the eyes of Him to whom we must give account.
Sheol is naked before God, and Abaddon has no covering.

verses.text: For You formed my inmost being; You knit me together in my mother’s womb.

xrefs.text: “Before I formed you in the womb I knew you, and before you were born I set you apart and appointed you as a prophet to the nations.”
Your hands have made me and fashioned me; give me understanding to learn Your commandments.
This is the word of the LORD, your Maker, who formed you from the womb and who will help you: “Do not be afraid, O Jacob My servant, Jeshurun, whom I have chosen.
Did not He who made me in the womb also make them? Did not the same One form us in the womb?
Please remember that You molded me like clay. Would You now return me to dust?

verses.text: I praise You, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Marvelous are Your works, and I know this very well.

xrefs.text: Then God said, “Let Us make man in Our image, after Our likeness, to rule over the fish of the sea and the birds of the air, over the livestock, and over all the earth itself and every creature that crawls upon it.”
Great are the works of the LORD; they are pondered by all who delight in them.
How many are Your works, O LORD! In wisdom You have made them all; the earth is full of Your creatures.
For You, O LORD, have made me glad by Your deeds; I sing for joy at the works of Your hands.
Many, O LORD my God, are the wonders You have done, and the plans You have for us— none can compare to You— if I proclaim and declare them, they are more than I can count.

verses.text: My frame was not hidden from You when I was made in secret, when I was woven together in the depths of the earth.

xrefs.text: As you do not know the path of the wind, or how the bones are formed in a mother’s womb, so you cannot understand the work of God, the Maker of all things.
For You formed my inmost being; You knit me together in my mother’s womb.
Your hands shaped me and altogether formed me. Would You now turn and destroy me?
But those who seek my life to destroy it will go into the depths of the earth.

verses.text: Your eyes saw my unformed body; all my days were written in Your book and ordained for me before one of them came to be.

xrefs.text: You have taken account of my wanderings. Put my tears in Your bottle— are they not in Your book?

At that time those who feared the LORD spoke with one another, and the LORD listened and heard them. So a scroll of remembrance was written before Him regarding those who feared the LORD and honored His name.

And I saw the dead, great and small, standing before the throne. And books were opened, and one of them was the Book of Life. And the dead were judged according to their deeds, as recorded in the books.

verses.text: How precious to me are Your thoughts, O God, how vast is their sum!

xrefs.text: Many, O LORD my God, are the wonders You have done, and the plans You have for us— none can compare to You— if I proclaim and declare them, they are more than I can count.
For I know the plans I have for you, declares the LORD, plans to prosper you and not to harm you, to give you a future and a hope.
“For My thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways My ways,” declares the LORD.
How great are Your works, O LORD, how deep are Your thoughts!
How precious is Your loving devotion, O God, that the children of men take refuge in the shadow of Your wings!

verses.text: If I were to count them, they would outnumber the grains of sand; and when I awake, I am still with You.

xrefs.text: I lie down and sleep; I wake again, for the LORD sustains me.
You search out my path and my lying down; You are aware of all my ways.
Many, O LORD my God, are the wonders You have done, and the plans You have for us— none can compare to You— if I proclaim and declare them, they are more than I can count.
He died for us so that, whether we are awake or asleep, we may live together with Him.
I have set the LORD always before me. Because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.

verses.text: O God, that You would slay the wicked— away from me, you bloodthirsty men—

xrefs.text: You destroy those who tell lies; the LORD abhors the man of bloodshed and deceit.
Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may obey the commandments of my God.

but with righteousness He will judge the poor, and with equity He will decide for the lowly of the earth. He will strike the earth with the rod of His mouth and slay the wicked with the breath of His lips.
The wicked will return to Sheol— all the nations who forget God.
Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for the LORD has heard my weeping.

verses.text: who speak of You deceitfully; Your enemies take Your name in vain.

xrefs.text: to execute judgment on everyone, and to convict all the ungodly of every ungodly act of wickedness and every harsh word spoken against Him by ungodly sinners.”
You shall not take the name of the LORD your God in vain, for the LORD will not leave anyone unpunished who takes His name in vain.
Remember how the enemy has mocked You, O LORD, how a foolish people has spurned Your name.
Rise up, O God; defend Your cause! Remember how the fool mocks You all day long.
Why do the nations rage and the peoples plot in vain?

verses.text: Do I not hate those who hate You, O LORD, and detest those who rise against You?

xrefs.text: I look on the faithless with loathing because they do not keep Your word.
I hate those who cling to worthless idols, but in the LORD I trust.
I know your deeds, your labor, and your perseverance. I know that you cannot tolerate those who are evil, and you have tested and exposed as liars those who falsely claim to be apostles.
I hate the mob of evildoers, and refuse to sit with the wicked.
Jehu son of Hanani the seer went out to confront him and said to King Jehoshaphat, “Should you help the wicked and love those who hate the LORD? Because of this, the wrath of the LORD is upon you.

verses.text: I hate them with perfect hatred; I count them as my enemies.

xrefs.text: I will set no worthless thing before my eyes. I hate the work of those who fall away; it shall not cling to me.
“If anyone comes to Me and does not hate his father and mother and wife and children and brothers and sisters— yes, even his own life— he cannot be My disciple.

verses.text: Search me, O God, and know my heart; test me and know my concerns.

xrefs.text: Test me, O LORD, and try me; examine my heart and mind.
so that the proven character of your faith— more precious than gold, which perishes even though refined by fire— may result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ.
let God weigh me with honest scales, that He may know my integrity.
A crucible for silver and a furnace for gold, but the LORD is the tester of hearts.

Remember that these forty years the LORD your God led you all the way in the wilderness, so that He might humble you and test you in order to know what was in your heart, whether or not you would keep His commandments.

verses.text: See if there is any offensive way in me; lead me in the way everlasting.

xrefs.text: Teach me to do Your will, for You are my God. May Your good Spirit lead me on level ground.
The heart is deceitful above all things and beyond cure. Who can understand it?
Good and upright is the LORD; therefore He shows sinners the way.
You have made known to me the path of life; You will fill me with joy in Your presence, with eternal pleasures at Your right hand.
I run in the path of Your commandments, for You will enlarge my heart.
